treatment.title: EECP therapy at BodyFlow Amsterdam
treatment.intro: EECP therapy is for people who want to support circulation, resilience and recovery without an invasive intervention. This page explains how the treatment works, which benefits clients often seek, and how a trajectory is structured.

costs.title: EECP therapy costs
costs.intro: What does EECP therapy cost at BodyFlow Amsterdam? The total investment depends on the intake, the number of sessions and the level of support that fits your trajectory. Below you can see both the package options and the individual rates.

sections.title: A clear structure for intake, sessions and added support
sections.body: We keep the pricing deliberately transparent. You start with an intake and then choose the route that matches your goals: individual sessions, a package with extra support, or a more structured clinical trajectory.

whoItsFor.title: Who EECP therapy may be for
whoItsFor.intro: EECP therapy is often considered by people who want to seriously improve cardiovascular support, energy or recovery. Suitability is never assumed, which is why every recommendation starts with a medical assessment.

sections.title: Often relevant for recovery, reduced capacity and performance goals
sections.body: Clients often come in with persistent fatigue, limited exercise tolerance, a need for structured recovery after illness, or a wish to improve physical and mental resilience.

sections.title: Intake first, then a treatment recommendation
sections.body: This page is not meant to make broad medical claims. Its purpose is to explain that the intake determines whether EECP is useful, safe and proportionate in your situation.
items: People who want to support recovery and circulation after an intense period.

People who want a structured trajectory with medical intake and monitoring.

eecp.h2: Restore your natural circulation with EECP therapy
eecp.intro: A clinically proven, non-invasive method for cardiovascular optimisation and vital recovery.
eecp.whatText: At BodyFlow Amsterdam we approach health at its core: unobstructed flow through your vascular system. Enhanced External Counterpulsation (EECP) is an advanced technology that acts as a 'natural bypass'. Without surgery or medication, we stimulate your body to improve blood circulation and form new capillaries.
eecp.howTitle: How does it work? The power of synchronisation
eecp.howText: EECP therapy uses precisely calibrated pressure cuffs around the calves, thighs and hips. The treatment is fully synchronised with your own heart rhythm via an ECG monitor:
eecp.howLi1: During the rest phase the cuffs inflate rapidly. This pushes oxygen-rich blood back to the heart and brain at the moment the blood vessels are most receptive.
eecp.howLi2: During the contraction phase the cuffs deflate immediately. This creates space in the vessels, allowing the heart to pump blood throughout the body with significantly less resistance.
eecp.physText: This rhythmic 'pulsation' does more than move blood. It activates processes in your body:
eecp.physLi1: The formation of new micro-vessels for improved long-term circulation.
eecp.physLi2: Helps relax blood vessels and keep vessel walls healthy.
eecp.physLi3: Supports the body in removing waste products and reducing systemic inflammation.

voordelen.h2: What EECP can do for you

benefits.subtitle: Cardiovascular Strength
benefits.title: Strengthening the Cardiovascular System
benefits.text: EECP works like a 'passive marathon'. The rhythmic counter-pressure stimulates the formation of new micro-vessels (angiogenesis) and improves the condition of your vessel walls. This relieves the heart and ensures a more efficient circulation, even at rest.

benefits.subtitle: Energy & Vitality Restoration
benefits.title: Restoring Energy and Vitality
benefits.text: By optimizing blood flow to tissues and organs, EECP restores natural balance and vitality. It helps reduce fatigue (e.g., Long-COVID) and stimulates microcirculation throughout the body. As a result, EECP provides an effective solution for erectile dysfunction while giving your daily energy a sustainable boost.

benefits.subtitle: Mental Clarity Focus
benefits.title: Mental Clarity and Focus
benefits.text: Vitality does not stop at the body. Improved circulation to the brain helps reduce 'brain fog'. Clients often report sharper thinking, better concentration and greater mental resilience.

benefits.subtitle: Physical Recovery Accelerated
benefits.title: Accelerated Physical Recovery
benefits.text: The pulsating action helps the body remove metabolic waste products more quickly and reduce systemic inflammation. This is crucial for both elite athletes and patients recovering from prolonged illness or physical exhaustion.

traject.subtitle: A carefully composed path towards cardiovascular excellence.

steps.title: CLINICAL CONSULTATION
steps.text: Your journey begins with an in-depth intake conducted by our specialist cardiologist. This is not a standard check-up, but a comprehensive medical assessment of your cardiovascular system, medical history and personal vitality goals. We ensure that EECP therapy is the safest and most effective method for your unique physiology.

steps.title: PERSONALISED PROTOCOL
steps.text: Based on the clinical intake, we design a tailor-made treatment plan. Whether you are recovering from Long-COVID, dealing with Angina Pectoris or striving for top-level physical optimisation: your 'Flow Protocol' is precisely calibrated to the specific needs of your body, including the frequency and intensity of the sessions.

steps.title: THE EECP SESSION
steps.text: You undergo the therapy in the professional setting of our studio in Amsterdam. While you rest, our synchronised technology initiates the rhythmic pressure increase via precisely calibrated pressure cuffs. For you this is a moment of physical rest, while your vascular system completes a vital 'passive marathon' for improved circulation.

steps.title: MONITORING & OPTIMISATION
steps.text: Health optimisation is a continuous process. During your sessions we monitor your progress and adjust the protocol in real-time if necessary. We provide deep insight into your cardiovascular recovery and support you in translating this improved energy into your daily performance.

pakketten.intakeText: Every journey begins with a medical intake to establish your suitability and the optimal treatment route. This comprehensive examination by our cardiologist includes an ECG, echocardiography and a bicycle stress test. This guarantees a treatment plan precisely tailored to your personal cardiovascular status.
